name: scriptrunner
description: Work on ScriptRunner from your agent. Explore and change ScriptRunner for Jira Cloud listeners, scheduled jobs, workflow rules, behaviours, and Script Manager files, test a scripted field, and read execution logs to find out why a script failed. Comes with ScriptRunner documentation, example scripts, platform guidance, and Atlassian REST API specs for Cloud and Data Center. Try "why did my listener fail last night?" or "write a scheduled job that closes stale work items".
